text: Ya Devi Sarvabhuteshu Chandraghanta Rupena Samsthita |
I repeatedly bow to the Mother Goddess, who resides in all beings in the form of Devi Chandraghanta.
I pray that the Mother Goddess, who is seated on a supreme vehicle, adorned with powerful weapons to counter enemies, and renowned by the name Chandraghanta, may bestow her grace upon me.
The essence of this prayer is,
This is a prayer that meditates on the Mother Goddess's powerful form and seeks her blessings.
